units.source_text: 但是，我确实在半夜看见父亲，一个人凝视着那些雏人偶。

en.t: But I truly saw my father at midnight, alone and gazing at those hina dolls.

units.source_text: 即便那只是一场梦，我也心无遗憾。

en.t: Even if it was only a dream, I have no regrets.

units.source_text: 总而言之，我眼前的看到的父亲和我一样，都对雏人偶万分不舍……

en.t: In short, the father I saw before me, like me, was deeply reluctant to part with the hina dolls...

units.source_text: 尽管如此，父亲仍然是个严肃的父亲。

en.t: Even so, my father was still a stern father.
